title: CRISPR generation of CSF1R-G795A human microglia for robust microglia replacement in a chimeric mouse model
protocol: Reconstitute vials of Matrigel in a bucket of ice.
Leave Matrigel at 4°C overnight to thaw.
Aliquot 1 mg of Matrigel into prechilled (-80°C) conical vials.
Store aliquots at -80°C for long-term storage.
Remove an aliquot of Matrigel from -80°C and allow it to thaw at 4°C for 1 hour.
Resuspend 1 mg Matrigel in 12 mL of 4°C cold DMEM.
Plate 1 mg of Matrigel per plate according to the well type (e.g., 2 mLs for a 6-well plate, 1 mL for a 12-well plate).
Wrap Matrigel-coated plates with Parafilm and keep at 20°C–22°C for at least 1 hour before use.
Store coated plates at 4°C for long-term storage if not used immediately.
Dissolve 1 mg Thiazovivin (TZ) in 642 mL DMSO to make a 5 nM stock solution.
Aliquot the TZ stock into 20 μL aliquots and store at -20°C for long-term storage.
Add 0.35 μL of TZ to 10 mL TeSR-E8 Media to prepare TZ-E8 media (0.17 μM).
Store prepared TZ-E8 media at 4°C, stable for up to two weeks.
Wash face, hands, and any exposed skin thoroughly after handling Thiazovivin (TZ) due to potential acute toxicity if ingested.
Dissolve 10 nmol crRNA in 50 μL Duplex Buffer (200 μM) on ice.
Aliquot 3 μl aliquots of dissolved crRNA and store at −20°C for long-term storage.
Resuspend 20 nmol tracrRNA in 100 μL Duplex Buffer (200 μM) on ice.
Aliquot 3 μl aliquots of resuspended tracrRNA and store at −20°C for long-term storage.
Thaw HiFi Cas9 Nuclease V3 on ice.
Aliquot 6.8 μl aliquots of thawed HiFi Cas9 Nuclease and store at −20°C for long-term storage.
Resuspend 20 nmol ssODN template in 100 μL Nuclease-Free Water (200 μM).
Aliquot 2 μl aliquots of resuspended ssODN template and store at −20°C for long-term storage.
Remove TeSR-E8 media from 4°C to warm at 20°C–22°C.
Prepare 0.17 μM TZ-E8 Media.
Thaw frozen iPSC line in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer frozen cell suspension to a 15 mL conical vial.
Add 5 mL TZ-E8 media to the vial.
Spin at 200 × g for 2 min.
Aspirate DMEM from Matrigel-coated 6-well plate.
Use P1000 pipette to slowly remove excess media, leaving ∼700 μL of media in the conical vial.
Tap conical vial with finger to break pellet into clumps.
Add total volume desired to split cell population to new wells.
Plate cells in 6-well plate (2 mL per well) and place in 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
After 24 hours, change the media to TeSR-E8 media without TZ.
Change media every day with fresh media, ensuring not to disturb attached iPSCs.
Aspirate media from well when iPSCs reach 70% confluency in a 6-well plate.
Wash cells with 1 mL DPBS.
Aspirate DPBS.
Add 1 mL ReLeSR per well for 1–2 minutes.
Aspirate ReLeSR and allow the well to sit dry for 3 minutes.
Add 1 mL TZ-E8 media gently to the wall of each well.
Replace lid and tap side of plate with palm of your hand.
Transfer resuspended cells to a 15 mL conical vial.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 2 minutes.
Aspirate TZ-E8 media from the conical vial, leaving approximately 700 μL of media.
Use P1000 pipette to slowly remove excess media.
Tap conical vial with finger to break pellet into clumps.
Split iPSC suspension to a 1:18 ratio on Matrigel-coated 6-well plates for continued culture by resuspending in TZ-E8 media.
After 24 hours, aspirate media from well when wells are 70% confluent.
Wash cells with 1 mL DPBS per well.
Aspirate DPBS.
Add 1 mL ReLeSR per well for 1–2 minutes.
Aspirate ReLeSR and allow the well to sit dry for 3 minutes.
Add 750 μL Bambanker serum-free cell freezing medium.
Replace lid and tap side of plate with palm of your hand.
Transfer resuspended cells to cryotube vial (one well per vial).
Store at −80°C for 24 hours.
Transfer vials to liquid nitrogen storage the following day for long-term storage.
Anneal crRNA and tracrRNA at 95°C for 5 minutes to prepare gRNA.
Combine prepared gRNA with HiFi Cas9 at room temperature for 15 minutes to generate RNP Complex.
Culture adherent cells with prewarmed Accutase at 37°C for 3 minutes before resuspending cells in ClonR-E8 media.
Count and centrifuge 500,000 iPSCs for electroporation.
Combine RNP complex, ssODN template, and iPSCs into cuvette.
Resuspend cells in ClonR-E8 media after electroporation.
Plate resuspended cells in a 12-well plate for overnight recovery.
Aspirate TeSR-E8 media from iPSCs and plate CloneR-E8 media for at least 1 h before lifting cells for electroporation.
Remove aliquot of crRNA and tracrRNA and place on ice to thaw.
Combine 3 μL crRNA and 3 μL tracrRNA into a PCR tube.
Heat the mixture at 95°C for 5 min to anneal.
Remove the mixture and allow it to cool at 20°C–22°C for 5 min.
Remove an aliquot of HiFi Cas9 and place on ice.
Combine 5.1 μL gRNA with 6.8 μL HiFi Cas9.
Gently tap to combine volume.
Allow RNP complex formation to occur at 20°C–22°C for 15 min.
Aspirate DMEM from 12-well Matrigel coated plate.
Add 1 mL CloneR-E8 media to one well per CRISPR reaction.
Place the plate in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator to pre-warm the media for iPSCs.
Pre-warm 1 mL Accutase in a 37°C water bath.
Aspirate CloneR-media from the well.
Wash cells gently with 1 mL DPBS.
Aspirate DPBS and immediately add 1 mL Accutase per 6-well plate’s well.
Transfer the plate to the incubator and allow it to incubate at 37°C for 2 min.
Return the plate to the cell culture hood.
Aspirate accutase slowly using a P1000 pipette.
Add 1 mL CloneR media.
Gently wash cells with a P1000 pipette to lift adhered cells.
Transfer cells to a 15 mL conical vial.
Count the transferred cells.
Discard remaining cells after transferring 500,000 iPSCs to a clean 15 mL conical vial.
Centrifuge the 500,000 iPSCs at 100 × g for 2 minutes.
Remove the supernatant slowly using a P200 pipette.
Tap the conical vial gently to break apart the cell pellet.
Thaw the ssODN template on ice before use.
Combine RNP complex with the ssODN template using 100 μL nucleofection buffer from Human Stem Cell Nucleofector Kit 2.
Transfer the solution to the cell suspension slowly and tap the conical vial gently to mix the suspension.
Do not triturate the single-cell suspension with a pipette.
Transfer the suspension to an electroporation cassette immediately after mixing to prevent viability loss.
Place the cassette in the Amaxa nucleofector 2b and nucleofect at B-016 setting.
Remove the 12-well plate from the incubator.
Remove cassette from Amaxa nucleofector.
Collect 500 μL of pre-warm CloneR-E8 media and add to electroporated cells in cassette.
Collect suspension from cassette and plate cells drop wise into a single well of the 12-well plate.
Incubate for 24 h in 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator to allow iPSCs to recover.
Prepare six 96-well plates for single cell-plating (D0).
Aspirate DMEM from all wells of previously prepared Matrigel-coated plates.
Add 50 μL CloneR media to each well.
Place media-filled plates in the incubator to prewarm for single-cell plating.
Prewarm 1 mL accutase at 37°C in a water bath.
Remove the 12-well plate from incubator.
Aspirate CloneR media.
Wash cells with 1 mL DPBS.
Aspirate DPBS.
Add 500 μL warm Accutase to well.
Incubate in incubator for 1.5 min at 37°C.
Remove Accutase gently using P1000 pipette.
Add 500 μL CloneR-E8 media.
Gently flush well to lift adhered cells.
Transfer suspended cells to 15 mL conical vial and count.
Fill 100 mL reservoir with 15 mL CloneR-E8 media.
Add 100 single-celled iPSCs per plate (600 total) to CloneR-E8 media in the reservoir.
Using stereological pipette, add 15 mL additional CloneR-E8 media to the reservoir by gently moving along the length of the reservoir to mix suspension.
Remove pre-warmed 96-well plates from the incubator.
Using a multichannel pipette, plate 50 μL per well of cell suspension from reservoir.
Transfer all plates to 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Change media to TeSR-E8 media after 36 h (D3).
Change media daily with fresh TeSR-E8 media to promote healthy growth of attached iPSCs.
Begin screening 96-well plates to identify and mark non-clonal wells five days after initial media change (D8).
Continue screening wells over 5–7 day period as clones may begin to emerge from the corner of the 96-well plate, marking wells with single clone iPSCs exhibiting typical morphology.
Passage selected wells to 48-well plates when iPSC clones have grown to 30%–50% confluency.
Take sample of cell suspension for screening.
Coat 48-well plates with 1 mg/plate Matrigel in DMEM.
Aspirate DMEM from 48-well plate and add 500 μL of TZ-E8 media to each well.
Aspirate TeSR-E8 Media from all 96-well plates.
Add 100 μL DPBS to each well.
Aspirate DPBS and add 100 μL of ReLeSR.
After 1 min, aspirate ReLeSR and allow wells to sit dry for 2 minutes.
Add 100 μL of TZ-E8 media to each well after drying.
Flush each well with TZ-media using a clean pipette tip per well.
Transfer 50 μL of suspension to 48-well plate.
Transfer remaining 50 μL of suspension to 8-strip PCR tube for genetic screening.
Place 48-well plate in the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator and change media daily.
Isolate DNA from individual clone samples using Extracta DNA prep for PCR.
Centrifuge 8-strip tubes using tabletop centrifuge.
Aspirate remaining media from each tube using fresh P200 pipette tip.
Add 25 μL of Extraction Buffer.
Incubate at 95°C for 15 min using a thermocycler.
Add 25 μL of Stabilization Buffer to each sample.
PCR amplify targeted CSF1R sequence of each clone.
Send PCR product for Sanger Sequencing with G795A_F primer.
Interpret chromatograms in SnapGene Viewer to identify iPSC colonies with Homozygous G795A knock-in.
Passage correctly edited clones using ReLeSR when 48-well plates reach 70% confluence, transferring them to 2× wells of a 12-well Matrigel-coated plate.
When 12-well plates reach 70% confluence, freeze one well in a single cryovial and passage the second well to two 6-well Matrigel-coated plates for expansion and banking per clone.
Cryobank all wells when 6-well plates reach 70% confluence.
Analyze correctly edited clones for off-target effects using array comparative genomic hybridization analysis before proceeding with differentiation.
Perform sanger sequencing of predicted off-target sites chr9:+18565856 and chr16:-81062196 before differentiation.
Test correctly edited clones for mycoplasma contamination using MycoAlert Plus (Lonza, Cat #LT07-710) before proceeding with G795A-iPSC differentiation.
One day prior to plating iPSCs for differentiation, coat a 6-well plate with 1 mg Matrigel per plate in DMEM.
Aspirate TeSR-E8 media from the plates.
Wash cells with 1 mL DPBS.
Aspirate DPBS and add 1 mL ReLeSR.
After 1–2 minutes, remove ReLeSR and allow the plate to rest dry for an additional 3 minutes.
Add 1 mL TZ-E8 media to the plate.
Close lid and tap side of plate to lift aggregates of iPSCs.
Transfer suspended cells to a 15 mL conical vial.
Triturate the cells gently twice in the vial.
Plate 10 μL of the cell suspension onto an empty well of a 96-well plate.
Count aggregates under a microscope.
Collect the total number of colonies needed (480 colonies for a 6-well plate).
Transfer collected colonies to a clean 15 mL conical vial.
Resuspend cells in 2 mL/well TZ-E8 media using a serological pipette.
Plate 2 mL/well containing 80 colonies per well into Matrigel-coated 6-well plates.
Transfer G795A-HPCs directly into iMG-Complete Media for microglia differentiation or thaw frozen cells and transfer them.
Culture G795A-iMG in iMG-Maturation Media for an additional 3 days (D25-D28).
Change media to Medium A after 24 hours (D0), using Basal medium plus Supplement A at a 1:200 dilution, 2 mL/well of a 6-well plate.
Replace 50% of Medium A with fresh Medium A 48 hours after the original media change (D2) by removing 1 mL/well and adding 1 mL fresh Medium A per well using a P1000 pipette.
Remove all media from each well 24 hours after the 50% medium change (D3) using a P1000 pipette, then add 2 mL/well Medium B.
Add 1 mL/well Medium B every 48 hours starting on D5, continuing to D7 and D9 without disturbing adhered clumps.
Collect medium and cells from each well using a serological pipette when HPCs begin to appear and lift from adhered colonies (D10), transferring them to a 50 mL conical vial.
Centrifuge the collected material at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Replate Medium B supernatant to your wells after 48 hours (D12) if collecting additional cells, or discard the supernatant if not needed.
Collect HPCs for transplantation, cryobank them in Bambanker for long-term storage, or immediately transfer them to a Matrigel-coated 6-well plate for iMG differentiation.
Coat a 6-well plate with 1 mg Matrigel per plate in DMEM one day prior to the differentiation process.
Count suspended cells if proceeding immediately from HPC differentiation.
Plate 1 × 10^6 HPCs per Matrigel-coated 6-well plate in 2 mL/well iMG-Complete Media (D0).
Thaw frozen HPCs into a Matrigel-coated 6-well plate (D0) if starting from frozen samples.
Warm the frozen vial in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer the vial to a TC hood and remove suspended cells to a 15 mL conical vial.
Add 1 mL of iMG-Basal Media drop-wise to the wall of the 15 mL conical vial.
Add an additional 5 mL of iMG-Basal Media to the wall of the 15 mL conical vial.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant, leaving less than 500 μL of iMG-Basal Media.
Tap the conical vial with a finger to break apart the cell pellet.
Resuspend HPCs in 1 mL of iMG-Complete Media and count cells.
Resuspend the total suspension to plate 1 × 10^6 HPCs per 6-well plate in 2 mL/well iMG-Complete Media.
Add 1 mL/well fresh iMG-Complete Media every 48 hours for 10 days (D2, D4, D6, D8, D10).
On day 12, carefully collect 6 mL per well using a serological pipette and transfer the suspension to a 50 mL conical vial.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min on day 12.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend any cell pellet in fresh 6 mL iMG-Complete Media.
Plate 1 mL/well (D12).
Continue to add 1 mL/well fresh iMG-Complete Media every 48 hours for an additional 12 days (D14, D16, D18, D20, D22, D24).
If further maturation of iMGs is desired, on day 25 carefully collect 7 mL per well using a serological pipette.
Transfer the suspension to a 50 mL conical vial and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in fresh 12 mL iMG-Maturation Media.
Plate 2 mL/well on day 25 (D25).
Add 1 mL/well of fresh iMG-Maturation Media after 48 hours (D27).
Prepare iMG for transplantation or cryostorage on day 28 (D28).
Coat a 6-well plate with 1 mg Matrigel per plate in DMEM.
If frozen, thaw vial of G795A-HPCs or G795A-iMGs into Matrigel-coated 6-well plate.
Warm frozen vial in 37°C water bath.
Transfer vial to TC hood and remove suspended cells to a 15 mL conical vial.
Add 1 mL iMG-Basal Media drop-wise to the wall of the 15 mL conical vial.
Add an additional 5 mL iMG-Basal Media to the wall of the 15 mL conical vial.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant, leaving less than 500 μL of iMG-Basal Media.
Tap conical vial with finger to break apart cell pellet.
Resuspend HPCs or iMG in 1 mL iMG-Complete Media and count cells.
Resuspend total suspension to plate 4 × 10^7 HPCs or iMG per 6-well plate in 2 mL/well of iMG-Complete Media.
Allow cells to recover for 24 hours in an incubator.
Collect cells using a serological pipette after 24 hours and transfer them to a 50 mL conical vial.
Add 1 mL DPBS to each well.
Flush each well with the P1000 pipette, then add remaining cells to suspension.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL DPBS and transfer to a sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Count cells.
Centrifuge Eppendorf tube at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cell pellet at 6.25 × 10^4 cells/μL in DPBS.
Transfer tube to an ice bucket for transplantation.
Place P0 to P2 xenotransplantable pups on a clean cage over a heating pad with a nestle from the home cage.
Transfer pups onto ice for 2–3 minutes to induce hypothermic anesthesia.
Free-hand transplant 5 × 10^5 cells/pup at 8 sites using a 30-gauge needle affixed to a 10 μL Hamilton syringe.
Perform bilateral injections at 2/5th of the distance from the lambda suture to each eye, injecting into lateral ventricles and overlying superior cortex.
Inject into posterior cortex in line with forebrain injection sites, perpendicular to lambda at a 45° angle.
Anesthetize adult mice for 12 min and keep them under continuous isoflurane sedation after transferring them to a stereotaxic frame.
Prepare mouse for surgery by mounting the mouse to the frame and placing the nose cone, then tightening ear bars while keeping head level.
Shave fur from snout to ears using a razor and sanitize skin with iodine wipes.
Apply local anesthetic before making an incision along the scalp to reveal the skull.
Identify bregma suture at 0.
Move to anteroposterior coordinate of 2.06 mm and mediolateral coordinate of ±1.75 mm.
Mark skull with Sharpie.
Shave small indentation in the skull at marked coordinates using Dremel.
Remove syringe and wash with DPBS before collecting 4 μL of suspended cells for transplantation.
Reattach syringe to stereotaxic frame and re-zero at bregma.
Navigate to anteroposterior coordinate of 2.06 mm and mediolateral coordinate of +1.75 mm.
Lower syringe along dorsoventral axis to 1.85 mm, then rise to 1.75 mm to create a small pocket for injection in the dorsal hippocampus.
Inject 2 μL of cell suspension at a rate of 1 μL/30 s into the dorsal hippocampus.
Wait 4 min after injection to allow transplanted volume to diffuse into the targeted region.
Rise along dorsoventral axis to 0.95 mm to inject into the parietal association cortex.
Inject 2 μL of cell suspension at a rate of 1 μL/30 s into the parietal association cortex.
Wait 4 min after injection to allow transplanted volume to diffuse into the targeted region.
Elevate needle along dorsoventral axis until clear of mouse and remove from stereotaxic frame.
Clean syringe with consecutive washes of DPBS, 70% (vol/vol) ethanol, and DPBS before collecting 4 μL cell suspension for transplantation into the alternative hemisphere.
Navigate to anteroposterior coordinate of 2.06 mm and mediolateral coordinate of -1.75 mm.
Repeat injection steps to deliver 2 μL into the dorsal hippocampus.
Repeat injection steps to deliver 2 μL into the parietal association cortex.
Prepare mice for postoperative care.
Gently bring tissue surrounding the incision together and apply Vetbond adhesive.
Remove mouse from the stereotaxic and transfer to clean cage on heating pad to recover.
Provide mice with systemic analgesia, such as 2 mg/mL Acetaminophen diluted in water for 10 d.
Perfuse mice with PBS for immunofluorescence staining.
Isolate brains and drop fix them in 4% (wt/vol) PFA for 36 h.
Cryoprotect isolated brains in a 30% (wt/vol) sucrose at 4°C.
Section brains coronally into 30-μm-thick slices on a freezing microtome.
Store brain sections in a solution of 0.05% NaN3 in 1× PBS as free-floating slices.
Block brain sections for 1 h in 1× PBS, 0.2% Triton X-100, and 10% donkey serum.
Label brain sections with goat anti-IBA1 (1:200) and rabbit anti-Ku80 (1:100) diluted in 1× PBS and 1% donkey serum.
Incubate labeled brain sections overnight on a shaker at 4°C.
Wash brain sections with PBS after incubation.
Incubate sections with AlexaFluor-conjugated secondary antibodies (1:400) for 1 h.
Wash sections three times with PBS before mounting with Fluoromount-G.
Visualize and capture immunofluorescent sections using an Olympus FX 1200 confocal microscope.
